title: Cheyenne Compact Tractor Snowblower Introduction
reason: Discusses the layout and marketing strategies of a farm supply store.

tasks.task: Describe the layout and design of the store.

subtasks.text: Note the large showroom that accommodates both rental equipment and lawn and garden offerings.
Mention the need for more shop space and the desire to expand.
Observe that the facility has been in use for 12 years and is now being remodeled.

tasks.task: Explain the marketing strategy and customer flow in the store.

subtasks.text: Highlight the use of single slope building design.
Describe how people are made to walk through all merchandise to reach the parts department.
Mention the emphasis on large tractors in the compound to attract attention.
